task.title: Edit / delete a report
task.shortdesc: After a report is created, the SMS application send regular reports on the scheduled day

context.p: After a report is created, the SMS application send regular reports on the scheduled day every week. If you want to receive a report on a different day or about a different motor, you can edit the report to modify these details.
To remove a report from the Reports page, you can delete it.
